question: It is the oldest trade union organisation in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**AITUC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) is the oldest trade union federation in India.
 
• It is associated with the Communist Party of India. According to provisional statistics from the Ministry of Labour, AITUC had a membership of 14.2 million in 2013.
